body:
Surfaced by Codex on #489 (M4 integration review); pre-existing in the streaming write path (#364), not a merge regression.

`metadata::renew_pending` (`crates/core/src/metadata.rs:525`) does a blind `put` of each `pending:<id>` entry. If a streaming PUT stalls past `lease_ttl_millis` and the custodian GC runs, the pending entries and their uncommitted fragment bytes can already be deleted; the blind renewal then **recreates** the pending records, and the upload can later commit a chunk map pointing at bytes GC has reclaimed — an object published with missing fragments.

**Fix:** make renewal conditional on the prior pending entries still existing (and unexpired) — read + `require(pending_key, current)` per chunk, or abort the upload on a lapsed lease — instead of resurrecting lapsed chunks. Needs a red→green test in the streaming path. Deferred out of the #489 integration merge to its own reviewed cycle.

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: Streaming PUT: renew_pending can resurrect a GC-reclaimed lease (commit points at reclaimed fragments)
